item.text: {"diagnosis":"Candidate/bad runs overrepeat actions instead of changing strategy after ineffective attempts, especially clicks, no-ops, and scrolls.","expected_mechanism":"Tracking recent attempts and requiring a materially different next step after repetition should interrupt unproductive loops. This should improve progress and completion while adding only small state-tracking and replanning costs.","policy_text":"Track recent action–target–outcome tuples. Before acting, detect whether the proposed step repeats an ineffective tuple. After one retry, require a materially different strategy, target, or information-gathering step; if none exists, stop and report the blocker.
